chapter: Billie Holiday with the band (1971 session)
title: Incidents on the road that year
summary: Basie says Billie's book covers almost everything that happened on the road, and there were no outstanding incidents, just average travel.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Lead-ons. Well, what I really would like to hear is tell me about that year that you were all on the road, you know? Tell me about, you know, focusing on (inaudible), whatever comes into your mind. What were the things that happened or the, you know --
Well, do you know one thing? Do you know one thing? In her book, she put in there, put damn near had everything in there, what happened on the road.
Like what? What'd she have on there that
happened with us on the road? You see, I mean, there were really no outstanding -- Incidents?
Right, that really actually happened which you would just get into.
You know? Average travel, like we were, and--
